prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: single photo atlas for precise CSS crops in a camera-preset app concept preview; photography only, NO user interface.
Create ONE landscape image, exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels if possible. Divide the entire image into a mathematically precise 3-column by 2-row edge-to-edge grid, each tile square and exactly equal sized (512 by 512). Zero outer margin, zero gutters, zero borders; six photographs must meet directly at straight grid boundaries. Each photograph is a different fully independent square composition; no panoramic continuation across tiles.
Top left: misty blue alpine lake, distant layered high mountains, tiny dark pine trees along the shore; calm subtle reflection, restrained blue-gray natural light.
Top middle: Japanese street corner after rain, warm amber storefront window with modest old architecture and wet asphalt reflecting the light; no legible signage, no people needed.
Top right: pale golden grassland with distant mountain ridges and soft daylight, airy warm muted tones.
Bottom left: rocky coast and delicate foamy ocean surf, slate blue sea with crisp natural rock textures.
Bottom middle: quiet narrow woodland path in a deep green forest, delicate daylight falling between trees, rich natural foliage.
Bottom right: serene snowy alpine mountain and a small wooden cabin, quiet pale blue snow light.
Style: high-quality realistic travel photography with restrained fine film grain, subtle film colors, natural light, believable detailed textures, graceful simple compositions. All tiles consistently photographic and similarly refined, muted saturation, no dramatic artificial HDR.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no watermarks, no logos, no UI elements, no rounded corners, no white or colored empty edges, no frames. Tile boundaries at precisely 1/3 and 2/3 of width and 1/2 of height. Every pixel filled with photograph.
usage: AI concept photography for a camera preset app UI preview; does not demonstrate real Nikon NCP output.
